entries.test: Contemporaneous incident reports, documented ChatGPT outputs, and OpenAI's public explanations would establish whether a substantial malfunction occurred during the preceding two weeks, its duration, and how much remained unexplained by publication.
entries.note: The malfunction is asserted firmly; only the six-hour estimate is explicitly uncertain.

entries.test: Public comparative evaluations of Google and Mistral models released during the preceding two weeks would show whether each narrowed its performance gap with GPT-4 relative to its previous models.
entries.note: The plain reading is improved competitive performance against GPT-4; full parity is not required.
